description: This file provides handlers and commands for managing git bundle files, including creating, verifying, listing heads, and unbundling repositories via bundle files.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_create(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles creation of a new git bundle, parsing options, and invoking the bundle creation process.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_verify(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Verifies an existing bundle file for integrity and correctness.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_list_heads(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists the references (heads) within a bundle file.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_unbundle(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Unbundles the contents of a bundle file into the repository.
